note: model_class: the online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed), with probs being a legal probability obtained by passing randn through softmax. This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs plus the deterministic length/label contract as the machine-readable version of the task-statement contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints live in task.yaml. A hidden/perf case is a dict of {name + semantic fields}: name is a metadata key that the consumer strips before calling reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields to generate the inputs deterministically.

shape_family.out_layout: single-tensor 1-D packing: out[0:batch]=losses (per-sequence, reduction='none'); out[batch : batch+batch*max_time*num_classes]=gradients, flattened in (batch, max_time, num_classes) row-major order; dtype same as probs
